best.why: Clean co-branded juice label; direct proof of the partnership.

takeaways: The best unused piece is Group Edit Jason 1: it shows the whole influencer cast posed under red and teal light. Use it on the X Shadyside case study, the influencer-marketing service page and the influencer ROI blog, and a frame from 0:06 is a strong cover. Alex Nichols FINAL (4) is a polished solo reel missing from the site even though its sibling reels are all used. Sizzle Reel 3's sunlit shadowboxing and the Reel 5 box jump are clean, text-free hero-loop beats. The Paid AD Reel, already on the case study, is the best proof for the digital-advertising page. The 35 templated 'New Year, New Us' stories are static, dated and highly redundant, so leave them off the site.
